concept: Rules and agreements help a group work well together, even simple ones like classroom or game rules
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a group makes up a fair rule together so a game works for everyone
exercise.reflection_prompt: What made the rule fair? What might have happened without it?
exercise.practice: Student helps make a simple fair rule for a game or activity

assessment.success_marker: student can explain why the rule helps the whole group, not just themselves
